ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the horizontal axis in the figure is years, marked with time points such as 1980, 1990, and 2000; the left vertical axis represents the buried depth of the groundwater level, and the dashed line represents changes in groundwater level; the right vertical axis represents the amount of land subsidence, with the unit being millimeters, and the solid line represents changes in land subsidence. Then reason: the question stipulates that the groundwater level corresponding to when land subsidence exceeds 200 mm is the red warning water level, so one should find the 200 mm scale on the right vertical axis and read along the horizontal line to the intersection with the solid line. This intersection is between 1990 and 2000, and its position is closer to around 1996, so the red warning water level appeared around 1996.
